OVERALL VERDICT: The live 15m/60m hit-rate elevations are not a confirmed trading edge: after horizon-sized block bootstrap and Bonferroni correction (alpha=0.003125), 3/16 cells survive vs chance, 4/16 survive vs persistence, and 2/16 survive both. The accumulated 15m/60m market_only rates span 55.9%–72.3% versus persistence 43.1%–49.2%; the small, short live sample and third/regime variation are consistent with a trending/regime or sample artifact rather than a stable edge. The historical pooled walk-forward baseline was only about 51.7%–52.5% at 15m and 51.2%–51.7% at 60m, with naive intervals already known to be optimistic under serial dependence.
